Questions & helpTap to open
About Frame

Private, on-device editing. Your photo is edited on your phone or computer and is not uploaded to Frame.

Location data removed. Every saved photo is redrawn from scratch, so GPS and camera details in the original are not carried over.

40 platform sizes. Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, YouTube and more, each cropped around your face.

Free to start. Auto Glow, Looks and saving are free.

How do I keep my whole photo?

Choose a destination. Frame fits the whole image automatically and fills extra space with a soft backdrop. Under Formats, choose Whole photo or a clean white backdrop.

Where does my downloaded photo go?

On iPhone, check Files → Downloads. Use Export → Open share sheet to save to Photos when your browser supports image sharing.

What is free?

Everything in Frame is free today: Auto Glow, filters, makeup tools, sizing, captions and downloads, all running on your device.

What happens to my photos?

Your photos are edited on your device and are not uploaded to Frame. A reduced draft can be remembered in this browser if you leave that option on, and you can delete it anytime under My looks & drafts. Closing the page can clear your session, so download your work before leaving. Read our Privacy Policy.

Does Frame remove location data?

Yes. Every photo you export is redrawn from scratch, so hidden details such as GPS location and camera info in the original are not carried over.

How do I install it as an app?

iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Android: tap Install app when it appears on the first screen, or open the browser menu and choose Install app. On a computer, look for the install icon in the address bar.

Does it work offline?

If you install Frame and open it once online, it can work offline. Face tools need to have been used once online first so your browser can keep the detection files.

Can I publish straight to social accounts?

Download your image or use your device’s share sheet to finish posting in the destination app. Frame does not post to your accounts directly.

Privacy Policy

Last updated October 2026

Your photos stay with you

Frame edits photos on your device, inside your browser. The photos you choose are not uploaded to Frame, and Frame has no accounts.

What is saved on your device

If “Remember my draft” is on, a reduced copy of your photo (up to 1600 pixels) and your saved looks are kept in your browser’s local storage. You can delete them under My looks & drafts or by clearing your browser data.

Face detection

The first time you use Beauty or Auto Glow, your browser downloads a face-detection model and code from Google Cloud Storage and jsDelivr. Those services can see ordinary request details such as your IP address, but not your photos. Detection itself runs on your device.

Exports and location data

Photos you export are redrawn on your device, so hidden metadata in the original, such as GPS location or camera details, is not included.

Offline use

If you install Frame or use it offline, your browser may keep a copy of the app and the face-detection files in its cache on your device.

Website hosting

Like any website, our hosting provider receives standard request logs such as IP address and browser type.

Tracking

Frame does not use ads or advertising cookies. Frame uses Google Analytics to count visits and basic actions, such as uploading a photo, using Auto Glow, saving an image, downloading a Platform Pack or opening Pro. These reports include general information like your approximate city, device and browser. Your photos and face data are processed only on your device and are never uploaded or sent to Google Analytics. Ad personalization is turned off.

Children

Frame is not directed to children under 13.

Contact

Questions or requests: framephotostudio@gmail.com

Terms of Use

Last updated October 2026

By using Frame you agree to these terms.

Your photos

Only edit photos you own or have permission to edit. Do not use Frame to impersonate, harass or mislead anyone, or to create unlawful content. You keep all rights to your photos.

Results

Edits are cosmetic and results vary by photo. Always check the preview before posting. Frame is not affiliated with Instagram, TikTok or any other platform, and each platform may crop or process images differently.

No warranty

Frame is provided “as is”, without warranties. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for lost work or any damages from using it. Download your work before leaving the page.

Changes

We may change or end features, including adding paid plans in the future. Your use after changes means you accept them.
